verifications.claim: SpaceX successfully launched 25 Starlink satellites aboard a Falcon 9 rocket from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'SpaceX successfully launched 25 Starlink satellites from its Falcon 9 rocket... from Vandenberg Space Force Base'; R3: 'Starlink 17-35... Deploy 25 Starlink satellites... Falcon 9... Vandenberg Space Force Base'; R4: 'carried 25 Starlink satellites... Falcon 9... Vandenberg Space Force Base'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the launch details including 25 satellites, Falcon 9, and location.

verifications.claim: SpaceX launched them on Monday, April 6, 2026
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'on Monday, April 6, 2026'; R2: 'April 6, 2026'; R3: 'Monday, April 6'; R4: 'Monday, April 6'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources explicitly state the date as Monday, April 6, 2026.

verifications.claim: SpaceX launched them at 4:03 p.m. PT
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Monday evening, just after sunset... scheduled for Monday at 7:49 p.m. PT'; R3: 'Launch window: 4:03 to 8:03 p.m. PT'; R4: 'opening at 4:03 p.m. PT'
verifications.reasoning: Schedules indicate window opening at 4:03 p.m., but launch report describes evening (~7:49 p.m.), creating contradictory timing information.

verifications.claim: The launch followed a Sunday scrub
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The launch was originally scheduled for Sunday evening'; R4: 'Sunday Scrub Pushed The First Mission To Monday... scrubbed... due to upper-level wind shears'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm a scrub on Sunday leading to Monday launch.

verifications.claim: The mission launched from Space Launch Complex 4E
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E)'; R2: 'SLC-4E, California'; R3: 'Space Launch Complex 4E'; R4: 'Space Launch Complex 4 East'
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly name SLC-4E for the mission.

verifications.claim: Starlink 17-35 launched from Vandenberg on April 6, 2026

verifications.reasoning: Sources directly identify Starlink 17-35 from Vandenberg on April 6.

verifications.claim: Starlink 17-35 carried 25 satellites to low-Earth orbit
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Starlink 17-35... Deploy 25 Starlink satellites into low-Earth orbit'; R4: 'Starlink 17-35... carried 25 Starlink satellites to low-Earth orbit'

verifications.claim: SpaceX has additional Starlink missions scheduled for April 8, 9, and 11, 2026, according to the official SpaceX launch schedule
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2 (official SpaceX): No Starlink on April 8,9,11 (April 10 SLC-4E Starlink, April 11 SLC-40 NG-24); R3: April 9 Starlink 17-21; R4: Thursday (April 9) Starlink 17-21
verifications.reasoning: Official SpaceX schedule (R2) lacks these exact Starlink missions on specified dates; other sources partially match April 9 but contradict overall.
